'''Allie Samta''' was a [[human]] member of the [[Resistance]]. Originally an infantry [[soldier]] in the Resistance's [[Resistance Army|army]], Samta saw the Resistance was in need of new [[Resistance pilot|pilots]] and transferred to the [[New Republic Starfighter Corps|starfighter corps]], training under veteran [[pilot]] [[Elna Zibsara]].<ref name="TROS VD" />

{{Char-stub}}

[[File:SamtaCobbenHug-TROS.png|thumb|left|250px|[[Merl Cobben]] and Allie Samta hugged before the [[Battle of Exegol]].]]

==Behind the scenes==
Allie Samta was played by [[Samantha Alleyne]]<ref name="Allie-Samta">{{Twitter|samkkalleyne|status/1209990116757950465|[[Samantha Alleyne]]|quote=Merry Christmas, happy holidays and seasons greetings to all my friends and family across the Galaxy ❤️ May the force be with you! Lots and lots of love, from Allie Samta ❤️ #theriseofskywalker #starwars|nobackup=yes|archivedate=20200105040512}}</ref> in the [[2019]] [[sequel trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode IX The Rise of Skywalker|''Star Wars'': Episode IX ''The Rise of Skywalker'']],<ref name="Episode IX">{{Film|IX}}</ref> and was first identified in the accompanying reference book ''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]'', which was written by [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="TROS VD" /> The character's name is very similar to the actress' name.<ref name="Allie-Samta" /> According to Alleyne, Hidalgo told her that Samta survived the events of ''The Rise of Skywalker'' and is still alive at the time of the [[Untitled Star Wars film (Sharmeen Obaid-Chinoy)|Rey Skywalker film]]<ref name="French Convention">{{Twitter|NuteGunray3|status/1784566492350026030|Nute Gunray|quote=There's a Star Wars Convention in France today, @GenStarWars, with actress Samantha Alleyne and she revealed that she is in Andor season 2! She also revealed that Pablo Hidalgo told her that Allie Samta, her character in SW9, will be alive at the time of Rey upcoming movie.|archiveurl=https://archive.ph/M5cXi}}</ref> in [[50 ABY]].<ref name="FutureofStarWars">{{OfficialYouTube|channel=@IGN|name=IGN|link=Wikipedia:IGN|video=qz6s7kvuwMc|text=Kathleen Kennedy on the Future of Star Wars | Star Wars Celebration 2023|date=2023-04-07}} establishes that the untitled film takes place fifteen [[Standard year|years]] after the events of {{Film|IX}}, which corresponds to [[50 ABY]] per ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''.</ref>
